app_context.description: Food-item level performance data report screen. Visually identical to existing Order Ledger and Food Court reports.

typography.headings: Use existing sans-serif font (standard Tailwind font-sans). text-zinc-950, tracking-tight. S7 Header Title: text-2xl font-bold.
typography.body: text-zinc-700 for standard data, text-sm for dense table rows.
typography.accent_text: text-[#F26B33] (Orange) for primary metrics like Net Sales and active tabs.
typography.subtext: text-zinc-500 for secondary information (e.g., item counts in accordions).

layouts.header_zone: Flex container with strict horizontal alignment. S7 pattern.
layouts.content_area: flex-1 overflow-auto bg-white m-4 mt-0 border border-zinc-200 rounded-md shadow-sm

S7_Header.instructions: Top navigation bar containing the 'Item Sales' title, back button, date range pickers, green Apply button, preset date pills (Today, 7D, 30D, MTD, 1Y, FY), column chooser, and orange outlined Download button. Must have white background and bottom border-zinc-200.
S7_Header.action_buttons: Apply: bg-[#329937] text-white. Download: border-[#F26B33] text-[#F26B33] bg-transparent hover:bg-orange-50. Presets: bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-200 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs.

KPI_Strip.instructions: 5 cards. Unique Items, Total Units Sold, Gross Revenue (₹), Total Discount (₹), Net Sales (₹). Cards have white bg, rounded-md, border-zinc-200, p-4. The 'Net Sales' card should have bg-orange-50/50 and border-orange-200 to stand out.

Tabs.instructions: 4 Tabs: 'All Items', 'By Category', 'By Station', 'Complementary'. Use text-zinc-500 for inactive, text-[#F26B33] border-b-2 border-[#F26B33] for active.

Data_Table.instructions: Flat or Accordion table depending on tab. Sticky header (z-20) and sticky TOTALS row (z-10) directly beneath it. Columns: Rank, Food Item, Category, Station, Qty Sold, Base Price, Variation, Addon, Discount, GST, Net Sales, % of Total.

special_columns.Rank: Display in a small badge (bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium).
special_columns.Net_Sales: Highlight text in orange (text-[#F26B33] font-semibold) mimicking Order ID behavior in other reports.
special_columns.Percent_of_Total: Show a horizontal progress bar (bg-zinc-100 with bg-[#F26B33] fill) alongside the percentage text.

Data_Table.accordions: For 'By Category' and 'By Station' tabs. Accordion header row shows: [Chevron Icon] [Category Name] - [N items] - [₹XX,XXX net]. Clicking expands to show item rows. Collapsed by default.

Popovers_and_Inputs.instructions: Search bar: standard input with magnifying glass icon. Column Chooser: popover with checkboxes. Download: Dropdown menu with Excel (.xlsx) and PDF options.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use shadow-sm for structural containers (table area, KPI cards). No excessive blur.
visual_enhancers.empty_state: If Complementary tab is empty, show a centered empty state illustration/icon with text 'No complementary items found for this period'.

motion.interactions: Add hover states to all buttons, table rows (hover:bg-zinc-50), and tabs. Add transition-transform to accordion chevrons (rotate-180 when open).

accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#F26B33] focus:outline-none for interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-expanded on accordion trigger rows.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Add data-testid to every interactive element (e.g., 'back-button', 'date-apply-button', 'tab-all-items', 'download-menu-trigger', 'table-row-item').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: CREATE .js FILES ONLY. DO NOT CREATE .tsx FILES.
You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold while strictly adhering to the specific #F26B33 and #329937 brand colors requested.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds on headers or sticky elements.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
Use lucide-react for all icons (ChevronDown, Search, Download, Columns, ArrowLeft, etc.). Never use emojis as icons.
Ensure the sticky TOTALS row stays pinned exactly below the table column headers (calculate top offset accurately).
Use 2-3x more generous padding in empty states or standalone layouts, but stick to dense, high-utility spacing (p-2 to p-4) inside the data tables to maximize visibility on the POS desktop screen.

Build Shadcn-style components locally in HTML/Tailwind if Shadcn isn't pre-installed for complex features, but maintain robust state management for the accordions, column toggling, and date selection.
All test IDs must be kebab-case and role-based.
